attack: A valid signed permit constituted for RECIPIENT-A is presented through the frozen v0.3.1 broker with the execution target substituted to RECIPIENT-B.
bounded_finding: Under frozen deterministic P2-H02, a permit issued for one target did not authorize execution against a different target.
nonclaim: This establishes only the frozen deterministic target-binding behavior of the tested permit/firewall/broker path. It does not establish all forms of action mutation or production-system behavior.
